== Summary ==
Before/after crops for [[Blizzard Scout 1 (PC Errata 2018 E card)]]. Compared with [[Blizzard Scout 1 (PC Errata 2017 slip)]] (31 May 2017). The 2017 slip and the same area of the 2018 image, scaled to the slip's width; nothing else is edited. Made by placing the two crops side by side (Bill, 12 November 2026: every version article shows cropped screenshots of what changed).

SHA-1 <code>354f6f862e2bdf71301f570752e323e58c7aaaaf</code>.

Fair use rationale: crops of copyrighted Star Wars Customizable Card Game card images, © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc. (errata by the Players Committee), used only to show the differences between versions on this non-commercial fan wiki.
